verdict.rationale: Resend's llms.txt names a first-party automations feature for marketing email ('build recurring flows with automations'), so the product itself offers background automations. The only evidence is that one-line mention. Broadcast scheduling is a one-off delayed send, not a recurring autonomous schedule, so it adds little to this story. Missing for 10: documentation of automation triggers, steps and conditions; evidence of recurring or autonomous execution beyond marketing flows; agent-driven setup of automations via API/CLI/MCP; independent or hands-on corroboration.
